resources.string: Skips sponsor reads, self-promotion and \"subscribe\" reminders in podcast episodes. Segments come from the SponsorBlock community (sponsor.ajay.app).
Skips intros, talking and skits in music videos when the community has marked them. Audio-only songs are not affected.

Hides channels known to publish AI-generated music from Home, Search, artist pages and radio suggestions. Uses the community AiSList (github.com/Override92/AiSList, CC BY-NC 4.0), refreshed daily and kept for offline use. Your own library is not changed.
This song can\'t be played. It was removed or made private, or it isn\'t available in your country.
Paste a public playlist or album link from Spotify, Apple Music or Deezer.
Only the song names and artists are read from the link (no sign-in). Each song is then found on YouTube Music and saved as a new playlist in your library. Private playlists can\'t be read.
This doesn\'t look like a Spotify, Apple Music or Deezer playlist or album link.
Couldn\'t read this link. Make sure the playlist is public and try again.
The link was read, but it has no songs.
Only part of this playlist could be read. Try again in a minute.
